# Director Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering

Share Post on X Apply now

Job Details ## Posting Details

* + Posted on October 26, 2026
* ### Locations
  
  Showing 1 location
  
  Durham, NC 27703, USA
* On-site
* Manufacturing & Engineering
* Full-Time
* Requisition \#: DIREC003457

### Description

**Job Summary:** The Director of Manufacturing Engineering is the overall department leader for  
Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Continuous Improvement across the manufacturing organization. Reporting to the VP of Manufacturing, this role establishes and executes the strategy, standards, systems, and talent required to translate product designs into safe, repeatable, efficient, and scalable manufacturing processes. The Director leads two integrated teams: (1) Manufacturing Engineering and  
Industrial Engineering, responsible for EBOM-to-MBOM transformation, manufacturing product structures, Methods of Manufacture, routings, work instructions, plant layouts, digital twin simulations, equipment capacity models, tooling, equipment, and machinery; and (2) Continuous Improvement, responsible for Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen events, 5S, Lean manufacturing initiatives, standard work, and structured problem solving. The role partners closely with Manufacturing Operations across several value streams, Product Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Planning, Facilities, and EHS to improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and manufacturing readiness while  
supporting new product introductions, capacity expansion, and growth across multiple manufacturing locations.
